findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_players" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Search for player identity by name. Always returns identity fields, but ownership context varies by platform. ESPN and Yahoo return market/global ownership and …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_user_session, get_transactions · Private data: get_standings, get_roster, get_players · Public sink: refresh_leagues · Destructive: refresh_leagues.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_user_session, get_transactions · Private data: get_standings, get_roster, get_players · Public sink: refresh_leagues · Destructive: refresh_leagues

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
